Mean, median, P16, P84, and P95 are calculated directly from the filtered values. Peak-bin center is the center of the most populated 0.1-mag bin and should be interpreted as an empirical distribution turnover, not as a calibrated completeness limit.
Non-finite, below-range, and above-range values are reported separately and excluded from the descriptive statistics.

Magnitude Error Statistics¶

Statistics include only finite magnitude-error values in the range 0 ≤ magnitude error ≤ 8.
Flux-error columns were converted to magnitude errors with sigma_mag = 2.5 / ln(10) * flux_err / flux. Non-positive, missing, and non-finite flux or flux-error values are converted to NaN and excluded from finite-value histograms and statistics.
Mean, median, P16, P84, and P95 are calculated directly from the filtered values. Peak-bin center is the center of the most populated 0.01-mag bin.
Threshold fractions use Count as their denominator. Non-finite, below-range, and above-range values are reported separately and excluded from the descriptive statistics.
